1.Senior Editor, Journal of Asian Economics (JAE, Elsevier), 1991-2007 Associate Editor, JAE, 2007-20

2.Am Committee of Asian Economic Studies (ACAES), Member (1991-2020), Executive Board (2002-06), Advisory Council (2020-)

3.Invited speaker, research scholar, and lecturer for various conferences (including TAA, NATPA, etc.), centers, institutes, and universities in and out of the USA. *Fulbright-Hays Research Fellow, National Fulbright Student Screening Committee member, etc.

Publication
1. Development Strategies of Open Economies: Cases from Emerging East and Southeast Asia, with Mei-Chu Wang Hsiao (MCWH). World Scientific (WS), 2020, xxxviii+338 pp.

2. Economic Development of Emerging East Asia: Catching Up of Taiwan and South Korea (with MCWH)), Anthem Press, 2017, xxii+293 pp. Cambridge University Press Cambridge Core, 2018.

3. Economic Development of Taiwan – Early Experiences and the Pacific Trade Triangle (with MCWH). WS, 2015, xxi+578 pp.

4. Economic and Business Analysis-Quantitative Methods using Spreadsheets, WS, 2011, xxxiii+636 pp.

See Amazon.com for details: https://www.amazon.in/Books-Frank-S-T-Hsiao/s?rh=n%3A976389031%2Cp_27%3AFrank+S.+T.+Hsiao

5. Pasokon de Geimu no Riron (Game Theory using Spreadsheets, with Y. Umehara), Nihon Hyoronsha, 1997, 212 pp. 2nd printing,1999.

Many other publications in professional journals and book chapters.

Fixing, Learning, Reading, Singing, Traveling.
